main_text.p: amicos in itinere & Parisiis salutes, ho-sce potissimum, Senis, Gulielmum Sohier, virum perhumanum & doctum, & Illustrissimum Dominum Piccolomi-naeum Archiepiscopum; Pisii, Paga-nium Gaudentium, virum multis libris editis clarum, qui tuo congressu vehe-menter delectabitur; Liburni, Spiri-donem, Monachum Graecum Ecclesiae Graecae ibidem praefectum καλλιγεράφος[?], à quo forte aliquid missorum nancisci poteris; Aquisextiis, fratrem Illustrissimi Domini Peiresci, & Cl. Dominum Gassendum; Avenioni, Illustrissimum Dominum Episcopum Vasionensem, cu-jus Praenesten hic edi curo; Parisiis, Pu-teanos Fratres, viros omnibus nomini-bus optimè de me meritos, quibus me & mea studia diligenter commendes; tum Reverendum P. Sirmondum, Petavium, Vassaeum; & si adsit, Nic. Rigaltium, tum Dominum Cramoisy; roges Pa-trem Sirmondum, ut Theodoreti Episto-las Manuscriptas ad Eminentissimum Cardinalem nostrum remittat, ubi satis

page.notes: The Greek word καλλιγεράφος is doubtful in its final letters and accent; the image is small. Ink blots over "Illustrissimum" (line 10) and near "Dominum" (line 8) partly obscure letters, but the words are legible. The printed "s" forms are given as plain s. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
